1. Choose a pet
Use ◀ ▶ to pick the friend you like. Pets marked 🔒 are available from VIP. You can also see all pets at once in ≡ → Pet list.

2. Summon
The first time, allow ‘Display over other apps’ for Pocket Pet. With VIP+, every tap on Summon adds the selected pet, up to 5 at once. Pick a pet on screen and tap Send back to send just that one home.

3. Play together
Press and drag your pet and it follows your finger, flapping its arms. Let go and it drops to the floor. With VIP, flick it while letting go and it flies, bouncing off the edges of the screen. With VIP+ you can also shake your phone hard to send it flying.

4. Settings
Change the size, floor height and walking frequency in ≡ → Settings.

5. Send it back
Tap ‘Send back’ in the app or on the notification.

Troubleshooting
• The pet disappeared: check that ‘Display over other apps’ is still allowed.
• The pet stops after a while: turn off battery optimization for Pocket Pet in your phone settings.

Pocket Pet
Version %1$s

Spend your day with little friends that wander your screen.

Made by jellytoc

Effective date: November 27, 2026

Pocket Pet (the ‘App’) respects your privacy.

1. Information we collect
The App does not directly collect personal information such as your name, contacts or location, and the developer runs no servers. However, as described under ‘Advertising’ below, Google may process some information to show ads.

2. Information stored on your device
Settings such as your chosen pet, summoned pets, size, floor height, walking frequency and speech bubble on/off are stored only on your device. They are deleted when you uninstall the App.

3. Permissions and sensors
• Display over other apps: used to show your pet on the screen.
• Notifications: used to let you know your pet is running.
• Foreground service: used to keep your pet on the screen after you close the App.
• Motion sensor (accelerometer): used by the ‘Shake to fly’ (VIP+) feature to notice when you shake your phone. It only runs while a pet is on screen and the screen is on. Sensor readings are never stored or sent anywhere.

4. Advertising
The Free and VIP tiers show Google AdMob ads. To show and measure ads, Google may collect and use the advertising ID, device information and approximate location (based on IP address). In regions that require consent, such as Europe, you will be asked before ads are shown, and you can change your choice at any time under ‘Ad privacy settings’ in the menu. See Google’s policy (policies.google.com/technologies/ads) for details.

5. Payments
Purchases of paid content are handled by Google Play billing. The App does not receive or store payment details such as card numbers.
